name: commitproof
description: An audit trail for AI-written code. /ai-history answers 'how much of this repo did Claude help write?' in seconds from git history, no setup. /receipt-init then gives every commit a tamper-evident receipt (AI-assisted or not, model, Claude Code version, file hashes): hash-chained, signed, verified offline. /receipt-report turns the chain into change-control evidence for SOC 2, HIPAA or PCI audits.
